headline: Xavier Niel Clears Indian Approval for $5.9B Vodafone Investment
summary: French telecoms billionaire Xavier Niel secured Indian regulatory approval for his $5.9 billion investment in Vodafone Group, moving closer to becoming its largest shareholder.
why: Vodafone Group is a major multinational telecommunications company. Large equity stakes and changes in major shareholdings can influence corporate strategy and market valuation.

impacts.name: Vodafone Group
impacts.why: Secured major investment approval from French billionaire Xavier Niel.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory approval brings the investor closer to becoming the largest shareholder, signaling strong external backing.
